annotations.title: Audit SaaS Trust Center, SOC 2 & AI Subprocessors

description:
Audit or monitor external SaaS vendor Trust Centers (up to 500 domains) for security certifications, DNS IAM/SSO, and third-party or AI subprocessors.

Parameters: Requires domains (empty input returns 0 items at $0). mode="audit" runs statelessly, while mode="monitor" diffs against stateStoreName snapshots and uses emitBaselineSummary to control first-run rows; checkSubprocessors and checkDnsIam toggle deep checks, and concurrency bounds parallelism. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Persists monitor snapshots and optional webhookUrl alerts, isolates per-domain 403/timeout failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $5/1K audited domains or real changes ($0 when unchanged or WAF-blocked).

Use for TPRM vendor risk or SOC 2 gap prospecting; do not use for editing internal GRC workspaces or local SMB website audits (use audit_local_b2b_websites instead).

checkDnsIam.description: Query DNS CNAME/TXT/MX records to verify Trust Center hosting and SSO/IAM providers.

checkSubprocessors.description: Inspect /subprocessors pages and Trust Center content for third-party and AI vendors.

domains.description: List of 1 to 500 external SaaS vendor or prospect domains, e.g. ["apify.com", "linear.app"].

emitBaselineSummary.description: In monitor mode, emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary record per domain on its first run.

mode.description: "audit" returns complete security posture immediately; "monitor" compares against snapshots and emits only real changes ($0 unchanged).

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist baseline snapshots in monitor mode.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified in monitor mode when compliance or AI subprocessor changes occur.

name: audit_saas_trust_center

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Audited SaaS vendor Trust Center compliance and AI subprocessor records.

missingSoc2Lead.description: True when vendor lacks verified SOC 2 certification.
